name: Somaliland
notes: Former British Somaliland; de facto independent Republic of Somaliland since 1991 (no defined tag, cannot core)

name: Central & Northeast Somalia
notes: Mogadishu, Benadir, Shabelle, Hiraan, Bay/Bakool, Mudug, Puntland (autonomous 1998, no tag); no effective central govt in 2000

name: Jubaland
notes: Gedo, Middle and Lower Juba

name: Shewa
notes: Addis Ababa + Oromia Shewa zones/Arsi + Amhara North Shewa + Gurage/Hadiya/Kembata (SNNPR); ORO core

name: Hararghe
notes: Somali Region north/Ogaden (no Somali-Ethiopian tag) + East/West Hararghe (Oromia) + Harari + Dire Dawa; HAR ORO cores

name: Bale
notes: Bale zone (Oromia) + southern Somali Region (Gode/Afder/Liben)

name: Sidamo
notes: Sidama/Gedeo/Wolayta/Gamo Gofa/South Omo (SNNPR) + Borena/Guji (Oromia); SID ORO cores

name: Illubabor-Kaffa
notes: Jimma/Illubabor (Oromia) + Kaffa/Sheka/Bench Maji (SNNPR) + Gambela region; ORO GBA cores

name: Welega
notes: East/West Welega (Oromia) + Benishangul-Gumuz (Asosa); ORO BEG cores

name: Gojjam
notes: East/West Gojjam + Awi (Amhara) + Metekel

name: Wello
notes: North/South Wello + Oromia zone + Wag Hemra (Amhara)

name: Nairobi
notes: Nairobi + Central Province + northern Eastern Province (Meru/Embu/Isiolo/Marsabit) + Samburu/Laikipia; 1999 census scaled to 31.0M

name: Nyanza-Rift Valley
notes: Nyanza + Western + most of Rift Valley; Ilemi Triangle (Turkana) disputed by SUD/ETH - not claimed, whole-state claim inappropriate

name: Mombasa
notes: Coast (excl. Lamu/Tana River) + Machakos/Makueni/Kitui + Kajiado

name: Garissa
notes: North Eastern Province + Tana River + Lamu; vanilla SOM core removed (NFD irredentism not a live claim in 2000)

name: Tanzania
notes: Mainland Tanzania + Zanzibar (no separate state/tag)

name: Upper Nile
notes: Southern Sudan: Upper Nile, Jonglei, Unity, Central & Eastern Equatoria; SPLA insurgency (no tag) controls much of it

name: Bahr al Ghazal
notes: Southern Sudan: Western/Northern Bahr el Ghazal, Warrap, Lakes, Western Equatoria; SPLA insurgency (no tag)

name: Leopoldville
notes: Kinshasa + Bas-Congo + Bandundu; government-held

name: Stanleyville
notes: Orientale; Second Congo War - held by RCD-ML/MLC rebels and Ugandan army (no defined-tag war scripted, controller left blank)

name: Kasai
notes: Kasai-Oriental + Kasai-Occidental + southern Maniema/Sankuru; front line of Second Congo War (Kindu area RCD/Rwanda-held)

name: Katanga
notes: Katanga minus Tanganyika district; northern Katanga front line (RCD/Rwanda near Pweto/Moba)

name: Kivu
notes: North & South Kivu + northern Maniema + Kalemie; occupied by RCD-Goma / Rwanda / Burundi in Second Congo War (no controller set)

name: Luanda
notes: Luanda, Bengo, Cuanza Norte/Sul, Malanje, Uige, Zaire, Lundas; Angolan civil war vs UNITA (no tag)

name: Cabinda
notes: Cabinda exclave (FLEC separatists, no tag); VP province named 'Namibe' in vanilla - misnamed

name: Moxico-Bie
notes: Moxico, Cuando Cubango, Bie

name: Huambo-Benguela
notes: Huambo, Benguela, Huila, Namibe, Cunene

name: Zambia
notes: Lusaka + Copperbelt + Central/Eastern/Northern/Luapula/Southern (east)

name: Barotseland
notes: Western + North-Western + western Southern Province; vanilla BAR core removed (tag undefined)

name: Maputo-Gaza-Inhambane
notes: Maputo city/province, Gaza, Inhambane; 1997 census shares scaled to 17.7M

name: Manica e Sofala
notes: Manica, Sofala, Tete

name: Zambezia-Nampula
notes: Zambezia, Nampula, Niassa, Cabo Delgado

name: Khomas
notes: Khomas, Erongo (south), Omaheke, north Hardap; vanilla SAF core removed

name: Karas
notes: Karas + south Hardap; vanilla SAF core removed

name: Kunene
notes: Kunene + north Erongo + west Otjozondjupa; vanilla SAF core removed

name: Owambo-Kavango
notes: Ohangwena/Omusati/Oshana/Oshikoto + Kavango + Caprivi + Otjozondjupa; vanilla SAF core removed

name: Transvaal
notes: Gauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga, North West, Free State; 2001 census shares scaled to 44.0M

name: Cape
notes: Western Cape + Northern Cape + western Karoo of Eastern Cape; prov 5203 geo estimate falls in Namibia but its neighbours (542 & 893) show it is the SA Kgalagadi finger - kept

name: Natal
notes: KwaZulu-Natal + Eastern Cape (excl. western Karoo); Lesotho (4556) and Swaziland (7900) split out

name: Lesotho
notes: Split from 719 Natal (prov 4556 Maseru)

name: Swaziland
notes: Split from 719 Natal (prov 7900 Mbabane)

name: Comoro Islands
notes: Excludes French Mayotte (no state; COM claims it)

name: Mauritius
notes: Incl. Rodrigues; province named 'Seychelles' in vanilla - misnamed

name: Reunion
notes: French overseas department; vanilla MAD core removed

name: Diego Garcia
notes: British Indian Ocean Territory; no permanent residents (US/UK base personnel); Mauritius claims Chagos

name: Kerguelen
notes: TAAF research station staff only
